faqs.question: Can you handle dietary needs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Please add notes to your reservation and our chefs will offer thoughtful adjustments.

faqs.question: Do you have parking?
faqs.answer: Street parking is available; the Bergen garage is two blocks away.

faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?
faqs.answer: We keep a few bar seats for walk-ins nightly.

faqs.question: How do I book a large party?
faqs.answer: Email us for parties over 8 or for private dining options.
